entries.subject: DAMIT 3327: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-3327.txt. Model 3327, version 2019-05-07, pole (294°, 42°), period 29.3874 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: NEOWISE Gr12b: selected thermal size
entries.finding: The original IRSA query was rerun for asteroid 1404; its Gr12b row matches the retained diameter 83.9900 km, error 1.2790 km, fit code DVBI and mean epoch 2455209.2817005. D in FIT_CODE means diameter was fitted. This effective-sphere diameter provides an approximate display scale, not a resolved surface or an independent physical-volume fit to the shape.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The grid marks unmapped coverage: no registered global reflectance mosaic was found in the selected releases.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Source mesh and calibration preservation
entries.finding: The [original mesh](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/10501/shape.txt) is retained without changing its coordinates or connectivity. [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/pages/documentation) supplies the coordinate units, pole and sidereal-period conventions; its CC BY 4.0 terms and other credits are linked from NOTICE.md.

entries.subject: Integrated colors as a surface map
entries.finding: Disk-integrated colors and thermal fits do not supply positions on the surface or a registered regolith map. The diameter fit belongs to the separate selected NEOWISE calibration entry; it was incorrectly mixed into this entry during migration.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially resolved, reusable observation and its registration provide a measured surface product.

entries.subject: Hanuš 2023: consistency with the existing DAMIT solution
entries.finding: The existing-DAMIT table was checked: (294°, 42°), 29.3874 h, agreeing with the selected archive solution to the paper’s printed precision. Included as a source consistency check, not a newly adopted mesh or surface qualification.

entries.subject: Hanuš 2023: existing Ajax model
entries.finding: The paper’s existing-DAMIT-model table retains Ajax at pole (294°, 42°), period 29.3874 h, matching selected model 3327. This is not a new shape release to substitute for the current input.
entries.revisitWhen: A numerical replacement or independent constraint improves this specific shape/spin solution.
